title: Almost coherent rings
summary: Inspired from the work of P. Scholze on the finiteness of \(\mathbf{F}_{p}\)-cohomology groups of proper rigid-analytic varieties over \(p\)-adic fields, Zavyalov recently introduced the notion of almost coherent rings, which plays a key role in the almost ring theory. In this paper, we characterize almost coherent rings in terms of almost flat modules and almost absolutely pure modules, integrating numerous classical results into almost mathematics.
